method: For each anchor, use the primary issuer's stated embargo/public delivery time where available. A page's current crawl/update time is not treated as the historical first-public time.

anchors.basis: BLS page states transmission embargoed until 8:30 a.m. ET Friday, August 2, 2024; headline reports payrolls +114,000 and unemployment 4.3%.
BLS page states transmission embargoed until 8:30 a.m. ET Wednesday, August 14, 2024; headline reports CPI +0.2% m/m, +2.9% y/y, and all items less food and energy +0.2% m/m.
Fed PDF says 'For release on delivery 10:00 a.m. EDT (8:00 a.m. MDT) August 23, 2024'; 10:00 EDT equals 14:00 UTC. The HTML text contains 'The time has come for policy to adjust.'
BLS page states transmission embargoed until 8:30 a.m. ET Friday, September 6, 2024; headline reports payrolls +142,000 and unemployment 4.2%. It also records June and July downward revisions.
BLS page states transmission embargoed until 8:30 a.m. ET Wednesday, September 11, 2024; table reports all items less food and energy +0.3% m/m, the draft's core-CPI proxy.

marketMetadataCaveat: The retained exact-token CSV begins 2024-07-25T19:00:00Z while raw-market metadata lists startDate 2024-08-02T20:43:54.565Z. This audit does not alter the raw series or decide provider semantics; it records the discrepancy. All five source-public times are after the metadata startDate except the July jobs report, which is a pre-start event and therefore should be explicitly disclosed when interpreting its window.
